verdict.rationale: Ledgy's documented programmatic surface (service-account OAuth plus the auth, companyCaptable and companyTransactions operations) is read-only, for authentication and retrieving cap table and transaction data. The evidence documents no API operation for creating draft grants or queuing them for board approval. Granting and signature workflows are described only as in-app, click-driven features, so the axis applies but there is no evidence it is delivered programmatically.
